title: Valley Warm Roasted Italian Cheese Lasagna
description: A romantic Italian cheese dish featuring roasted vegetables and a creamy cheese pull, served from a warm terracotta dish.
instructions: Sauté garlic in canola oil until fragrant, then set aside.
Roast eggplant, zucchini, and red bell pepper in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Combine ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper in a bowl.
Spread a thin layer of marinara sauce on the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on the bottom of the baking dish.
Spread half of the ricotta cheese mixture over the noodles.
Add a layer of roasted vegetables, followed by a layer of marinara sauce.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of mozzarella cheese on top.
Sprinkle nutritional yeast and italian seasoning over the top of the cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh basil.
